nubsNob.comments:
It was cold enough to fire up the snowmaking system last night. Snowmaking continues this morning. A forecasted warm-up will likely force a shut down today.
Unfortunately, there isn't enough cold air for a Thanksgiving Weekend opening. The Lodge, General Store, Tune Center, Cafeteria, Pub, and Locker Room will all be open on Friday and Saturday following Thanksgiving from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Despite the warm fall we hope you will stop by this weekend as we all prepare for ski season. We will have the Michigan - Ohio St. game on in the Nub's Pub on Saturday. Think Cold and Snow!
